title: Ubuntu & Debian Security Notice: Polkit pkexec Local Privilege Escalation (PwnKit)
summary: Local privilege escalation vulnerability in pkexec. A local attacker could exploit this to obtain root privileges without authentication.

title: Red Hat Enterprise Linux Advisory: Kernel User Namespaces fs_context Heap Overflow
summary: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Linux kernel legacy_parse_param function in fs/fs_context.c when unprivileged user namespaces are enabled.

title: Ubuntu Security Notice: Dirty Pipe Linux Kernel splice() Privilege Escalation
summary: Vulnerability in the Linux kernel pipe implementation allowing arbitrary read-only file overwrites and unprivileged local root escalation.

title: Red Hat Advisory: Netfilter nf_tables Use-After-Free Privilege Escalation
summary: Use-after-free vulnerability in Linux kernel netfilter nf_tables component leading to arbitrary kernel code execution and local root escalation.

title: Ubuntu Security Notice: OpenSSH Server Signal Handler Race Condition (regreSSHion)
summary: Signal handler race condition in OpenSSH sshd leading to unauthenticated remote code execution as root on glibc-based Linux systems.

title: Arch Linux Security Advisory: openssh 9.8p1-1 (regreSSHion)
summary: Arch Linux package update upgrading openssh to 9.8p1-1 resolving the critical sshd signal race condition.

title: Ubuntu Security Notice: GNU C Library GLIBC_TUNABLES Buffer Overflow (Looney Tunables)
summary: Buffer overflow in the GNU C Library dynamic loader ld.so when processing the GLIBC_TUNABLES environment variable.
